# Active Feature Specification

> **Single Source of Truth:** This document holds the active functional specification and technical design for current project features. It is generated by `to-spec` or updated during grilling phases.

---

## 1. Feature Title
**SkilledAgent Always-Active Prompt Interception & Workflow Optimization System**

---

## 2. Problem Statement
AI coding agents often make unchecked assumptions, drop out of orchestrated skill workflows after a single prompt, fail to ask clarifying questions on ambiguous user prompts, and burn excessive tokens by re-scanning entire codebases and full markdown files repeatedly.

---

## 3. High-Level Architecture & Flow
```
User Prompt (Any turn / kickoff)
       │
       ▼
[SkilledAgent Interceptor] ──(Check ambiguity & conflicts)──► [SUMMARY_INDEX.md / CONTEXT.md]
       │
       ├─► [SKILLS_INDEX.md] (Match 44 skills with minimal token usage)
       │
       ▼
[Prompt Grilling / grill-me] (Clarify ambiguities, present implementation options, suggest skills)
       │
       ▼
[Shared Understanding Reached]
       │
       ▼
[Ticket Breakdown / to-tickets] ──► [Incremental TDD Loop] ──► [User Verification & Commit]
```

---

## 4. Key Requirements & Rules
1. **Always-Active Grilling:** Every user prompt requesting code changes must be evaluated for ambiguity, spec conflicts, and implementation options before writing code.
2. **Token Efficiency:** Consult `SKILLS_INDEX.md` and `SUMMARY_INDEX.md` before reading detailed files. Observe 12k markdown limit.
3. **Kickoff Flow:** Project Scan → Vision Intake → Big Decisions (Why, Stack, Architecture, Constraints) → Wayfinder → Deep Grilling → Spec → Tickets → Incremental TDD Implementation → Code Review.
4. **Incremental Execution:** Implement tickets one by one, request user verification, offer optional git commits per ticket, and run code reviews in clean context windows.

---
